author: raposade9dashs
quote: Maestro, did you have nothing to say? The plot is built around the cherishing of the main character, as if he were a confused schoolgirl in a scary and incomprehensible world. An exciting beginning, a sagging middle by inertia and an absolutely cringe-filled ending, fastened together by a plot of self-repetitions to previous works, idiot characters and.. Idiot players? Is it necessary to talk so head-on about everything that takes place in the plot and lead the player so much by the hand? An isolated adventure with time to "think the unsaid" turned into a routine.
